description: Register an AI agent on Badge and screen it against the standardized task catalogue, then return its fitness score. Requires a Badge API key (BADGE_API_KEY). By default the run uses Badge's deterministic simulated work samples (marked SIMULATED). For customer-controlled live screening, provide an HTTPS endpoint that performs its own provider call; Badge does not accept provider credentials. `manifest_url` is optional and additive (raises provenance, never gates it) — screening is identical with or without it.

domain.description: Restrict screening to one task domain (default: full catalogue).

domains.description: Comma-separated domain tags for the agent.

endpoint.description: Agent HTTPS endpoint (optional for simulated screening).

manifest_url.description: OPTIONAL — a signed BPP provenance manifest URL for this agent (mint one with `bpp init` from @badgeia/provenance, or hand-author one; see docs/RUNBOOK-provenance.md). Stored on the agent record so it can be verified later and raise the agent's provenance level. Purely additive: screening, scoring, and this tool's output are IDENTICAL whether or not you set it — nothing is gated on provenance.

name.description: Unique display name for the agent.

task_ids.description: Explicit task UUIDs to screen against (overrides `domain`).

name: screen_agent
title: Screen an AI agent on Badge
